caption:
A U.S. newborn in 1900 could expect to live 47.3 years. By 2018 that figure was 78.7, a gain of 31.4 years.

The series dipped to 39.1 in 1918 and peaked at 78.9 in 2014. Both sexes, all races; the dataset ends in 2018, and the trend depends on the years chosen.

Source: CDC / National Center for Health Statistics, "NCHS - Death rates and life expectancy at birth" (data.cdc.gov, w9j2-ggv5).
